_comment: Where a '<file>.gz' is a derived twin that webfs serves INSTEAD of '<file>' (so a stale one must go when <file> changes): exactly /www/shell/** and /apps/<id>/www/**, case-insensitive (FAT). Paths are SD-relative. Checked against the firmware (nucleo_fsapi/fstwin.c via tools/anima-host/fstwin-check.mjs), tools/lib/twin-scope.mjs and sd_deploy.py twin_scope().
